description: Inspect image loads reported through the Buoy image integration, including available cache origin, load timing, size estimates, errors and simulation overrides. Coverage depends on instrumented components and platform support. Requires @buoy-gg/images on the device.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

limit.description: Max records to return (newest first). Default 30, max 200.

status.description: Only records in this state (e.g. 'error' for the failure log).

name: get_images
